close_reason: Propagated server_fail_from_backend across all 8 extension *-server crates. Bulk rewrite of ~197 .map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string())) call sites to .map_err(|e| server_fail_from_backend(&e)) via regex. Three .map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(format!(...))) sites that interpolated {e}: two replaced with server_fail_from_backend(&e); one kept (only contained static text plus a JMAP Id, no leak risk). Imports added to 40 files via a smart-merge into existing 'use jmap_server::{...};' patterns. Workspace builds clean with cargo build/test/clippy/fmt --all-features.
description:
Propagation of bd:JMAP-wlip.2 to the 8 extension *-server crates per the canonical-template rule.

After JMAP-wlip.2 introduced jmap_server::server_fail_from_backend and fixed the 7 leak sites in the foundation crate-jmap-server/src/handlers.rs, ~203 analogous '.map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))' call sites remain in the extension *-server crates (counts approximate, from rg at JMAP-wlip.2 commit):

  crate-jmap-mail-server/      most sites (email.rs, mailbox.rs, sieve.rs, submission.rs, mdn.rs, etc.)
  crate-jmap-chat-server/      multiple per file across ban/contact/presence/emoji/space/message/chat/invite/position
  crate-jmap-calendars-server/ calendar.rs, event.rs, event_notification.rs, principal.rs, participant_identity.rs, helpers.rs
  crate-jmap-tasks-server/
  crate-jmap-contacts-server/
  crate-jmap-sharing-server/
  crate-jmap-metadata-server/
  crate-jmap-filenode-server/

Sweep strategy:
1. Per crate, replace every '.map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(e.to_string()))' with '.map_err(|e| server_fail_from_backend(\&e))' (the helper accepts any Display via 'Display + ?Sized' bound, so it works for BackendSetError, BackendChangesError, and any trait-method error envelope).
2. Add 'use jmap_server::server_fail_from_backend;' to each module that has at least one such call site (most already 'use jmap_server::...' something else).
3. Also handle the variant '.map_err(|e| JmapError::server_fail(format!(...)))' — these need case-by-case judgment: format strings that already contain only static text (e.g. 'unhandled backend error variant') are fine to keep; format strings that interpolate the backend error (format!("event serialize failed: {e}")) are the same leak class and should become server_fail_from_backend(\&e).

Test coverage: rely on the existing 'serverFail' assertion tests in each crate's integration suite. Those check error_type only, not description. After the sweep, optionally add a per-crate test analogous to handlers::tests::server_fail_from_backend_drops_display_text that exercises a leaky backend error through the crate's own handler stack.

Out of scope: JmapError construction sites where the description is caller-meaningful (limit, invalidArguments, invalidResultReference, stateMismatch with state values). Those carry information the client needs.
title: Sweep: propagate server_fail_from_backend helper to all *-server extension crates
